title: FigmaEval: A Benchmark for Evaluating AI Agents in Professional UI Design
abstract: arXiv:2611.32321v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in AI agents have enabled autonomous UI design using professional tools such as Figma, yet evaluating their design capabilities remains challenging due to the open-ended nature of design tasks and the absence of unique ground truths. We introduce FigmaEval, a benchmark for evaluating AI agents on professional UI design tasks, comprising 84 tasks and 783 screens derived from real-world Figma design files. FigmaEval adopts a constrained-specification, open-solution paradigm, standardizing task requirements and design resources while allowing agents to independently determine layouts, visual hierarchies, component composition, and visual presentation. To assess design quality beyond reference similarity, we develop 22 expert-grounded evaluation rubrics across six dimensions and introduce a human evaluation arena where professional designers compare agent-generated designs through blinded pairwise judgments. translated_title: FigmaEval：一个用于评估AI智能体专业UI设计能力的基准测试
translated_abstract: AI智能体的最新进展使得使用Figma等专业工具进行自主UI设计成为可能，但由于设计任务本身具有开放性且缺乏唯一的真实标准答案，评估其设计能力仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了FigmaEval，这是一个用于评估AI智能体在专业UI设计任务上表现的基准测试，包含84个任务和783个屏幕界面，均来源于真实的Figma设计文件。FigmaEval采用“约束规格、开放解法”的范式，在标准化任务要求和设计资源的同时，允许智能体自主决定布局、视觉层次、组件构成和视觉呈现方式。为了超越与参考设计的相似度来评估设计质量，我们开发了22项基于专家意见的评估标准，涵盖六个维度，并引入了人类评估竞技场，由专业设计师通过盲测的成对比较来判断智能体生成的设计。对十一个（模型/智能体的评估结果原文在此截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了FigmaEval基准测试，基于真实Figma设计文件、采用“约束规格、开放解法”范式，通过22项专家评估标准和专业设计师盲测竞技场来评估AI智能体的专业UI设计能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces FigmaEval, a benchmark built from real-world Figma design files that adopts a constrained-specification, open-solution paradigm and leverages 22 expert-grounded rubrics plus a blinded human evaluation arena with professional designers to assess AI agents' professional UI design capabilities.
